Navin's rules for this task (follow every one):
[G-01] Everything taught comes from the book. Knowledge from outside the book is allowed only to explain the book better; it is marked as outside, standard textbook-level and correct. Never invent facts, numbers, names or quotations.
[G-02] Work like the best teacher of these learners and this exam, not like a summariser. Depth beats brevity: nothing teachable on the page is skipped or compressed away, and every explanation makes a student understand, not just remember. Depth means understanding, not length: lesson narration keeps S2-01's time by cutting repetition and side-tracks, never book content.
[G-03] Before the output, fill 'notes' with brief notes for the reviewer and for Navin: what this unit is about, the key questions a teacher must answer about it, the main decisions you made with a one-line reason each, and anything uncertain. Keep the notes short; they explain the work, they are not the work.
[G-04] Learner-facing language follows the course setting. For the first course (UPSC / State PCS) it is Hinglish: natural Hindi sentence flow, English technical terms, the way Navin teaches.
[G-05] Never drop or compress away what the book teaches to fit a length. If a unit of work is too large, it is split by BIE into smaller units; within a unit, the book's content is complete. Lesson narration has a time target (S2-01), met by cutting repetition and side-tracks, never book content.
[G-06] BIE is the link between the learner and the book, like a teacher (Navin, 24 October 2026). The book is the base; BIE carries its text, easy or hard, into the learner's mind. Never just read the line out: every book line is opened (what its words mean, why it is so, where it is seen, what follows), at the depth of the level profile.
[G-07] Two layers, like a film (Navin, 24 October 2026). The writer layer (understanding, plan, script) decides what is said and how deep, following the level profile and the book's own level. The presentation layer (director, video blocks, render) is the same skilled quality for every learner, from class 6 to postgraduate; only the detail shown follows the level, never the craft.
[S2-01] Plan the chapter's videos from the chapter map: first one short 'pehle yeh jaan lo' video (5-8 minutes) that teaches the chapter's prerequisites, then the topic videos in teaching order. Narration is 6-8 minutes per book page (Navin, 23 October 2026; the 14-page tissue chapter about 85-110 minutes of topic videos, plus the prerequisite video): each topic video gets the share of the pages its items come from, and a very dense page may go up to 25% over when the plan says why. Understanding (Section 1) and the chapter map have no time limit.
[S2-02] Write a spoken teacher script in beats with a natural teacher flow. Stories and analogies only where they genuinely help that topic. Every item the book teaches is taught and every teacher question answered from the book is answered; questions answered from outside the book are used only where they help and the time allows. Cut repetition and side-tracks, never book content.
[S2-03] Prerequisites are only what this chapter directly needs, never a prerequisite of a prerequisite. They are taught, not named, in the chapter's 'pehle yeh jaan lo' video, each with a simple explanation and an example; a topic video may remind of them in at most 2 beats.
[S2-04] Spoken Hinglish the way Navin teaches, in mixed script (Navin, 21 and 23 October 2026): Hindi words in Devanagari, English words, above all the book's technical terms, in Roman exactly as the book spells them, as in 'आज हम tissue के बारे में पढ़ेंगे'; a genuinely difficult Hindi word (formal, literary or technical; not in BIE's everyday word list rulebook/simple_hindi.json) gets its English word in brackets right after it, as in 'सतह (surface)'; the screen and subtitles show the bracket and the voice says 'सतह, यानी surface'. Never a bracket after an everyday word or inside an idiom or a fixed phrase ('आम तौर पर', not 'आम तौर (usually) पर'; 'नहीं के बराबर', not 'नहीं के बराबर (equal to)'). Never an English term in Devanagari or a Hindi word in Roman. Numbers as digits; short spoken sentences addressed to one student; questions to the student and natural pauses; no reading out of lists.
[S2-05] Every beat states which chapter-map items it covers and which teacher questions it answers, and those claims must be true: the beat really explains that item and really answers that question.
[S2-06] Teach every part of a video through the universal frame (what the process is, how it works, when and in what order, under which conditions, in what atmosphere) and through the teaching pattern of its content type, step by step in the pattern's order; every item on the task card is really taught, none only named.
[S2-07] Open every book line in the script, never read it out (Navin, 24 October 2026). A new topic opens with a question about something the learner can see, then the name. After any book line the beat carries at least one of: the term's plain meaning with 'yaani' and an everyday image, a why step from a need, an example or the place. Speak complete sentences, not clipped notes. A classification is taught as a family: the overview tree, then every member in the same slots (layer and shape, why it is named so, its special feature, its function with its cause, where it is found by a zoom from the organ, its consequence), then the members compared and a memory trick. A pattern step may be skipped only with a stated reason; one recap per part and one closing recap.
[S2-08] Apply first, name after (Navin, 27 October 2026): in an economics script a concept's real-world example runs BEFORE the beat that names the term: the example beats carry the example's numbers (₹50 → ₹65, buyers 2 → 12 → 3) and walk the mechanism step by step; then the term ('isliye ise demand-pull inflation kehte hain'), then the book's definition, then one line on where the learner meets it in real life. The example is the one Section 1 chose for the item (its place, actors, goods, numbers), economically correct and at the learner's level. The numbers are said the way a teacher tells what happened ('pehle aapke paas 500 rupaye the, kiraane ke 100 diye, ab 400 bache'), never as a state report (S2-09). The term is not named before the example by any teaching beat of the same concept either (a sister part may not explain 'the UPI route' before the ₹100 kirana payment runs; a hook or a question to the student may ask about it): BIE's code sends such a script back. [S2-09] Complete teacher sentences (Navin's verdict on Money v1, 29 October 2026: 'teacher ki naration uske sentence aise poore ho ki banawati na lage aur cheejen samjhane ki process us par depend hai to unka complete tarike se istemal hona jaruri hai'): the narration tells what happened in full, natural sentences; a story's numbers are said conversationally ('pehle aapke paas 500 rupaye the, kiraane ke 100 diye, ab 400 bache'), never as a ledger's state report ('cash ₹500 से ₹400 हुआ', 'savings ₹0 से ₹500 हुईं'). [S2-10] Outside facts carry their dated source (the Money lesson resume -d, 29 October 2026, v10: operational descriptions of UPI, NEFT, RTGS and IMPS added real Indian banking knowledge beyond the book without a dated source): for a competitive-exam learner (level upsc_pcs), a teaching beat whose basis is outside the book, or mixed and naming an institution or system that none of its book lines names, carries its source with its year in `source` ('RBI, NEFT FAQ, 2023'); a story, example, hook, analogy or question needs none; a beat whose facts the book line says has basis 'book'. The source lives in `source`, never spoken or on screen, and BIE's code decides where one is due: a checker's demand for a dated source on any other outside fact, or for a visible outside label, is minor by code (the resume -e: the checker asked for dated sources in 10 of the 12 scripts it failed, after the code's S2-10 had passed every beat).

BIE's content types (the type of an item decides its required questions and how it is taught, shown, played and drawn):
- process · Process: Something that happens in steps or stages over time: a mechanism, a procedure, a cycle (photosynthesis, cell division, how a bill becomes law). Required questions: how (kaise), when (kab). Other questions: what (kya), where (kahan), why (kyun), consequence (nateeja).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the result first (what it makes). 2) inputs and the place. 3) each step with its cause and its condition. 4) what breaks when a step fails. 5) the whole run once more at speed. 6) recap as a flow.
- structure · Structure: Something made of parts arranged in space, each part with a function (a cell, a leaf, the heart, a machine, the Parliament). Required questions: what (kya), where (kahan). Other questions: how (kaise), why (kyun), which (kaun).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the whole in context. 2) zoom into each part in a fixed path (outside to inside). 3) function of each part tied to its shape. 4) how the parts work together. 5) labelled recap.
- classification · Classification: A group divided into kinds by a stated basis (types of tissues, kinds of rocks, kinds of writs). Required questions: which (kaun), difference (tulna). Other questions: what (kya), evidence (saboot), where (kahan).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the overview tree first: the basis of division and every member named. 2) every member in the same slots: layer and shape, why it is named so, its special feature, its function with its cause, where it is found by a zoom from the organ, its consequence. 3) the members compared side by side, the most confused pair named directly. 4) a memory trick for the family.
- comparison · Comparison: Two or more things set side by side on stated criteria (plant and animal cells, Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha). Required questions: compare (tulna), difference (tulna). Other questions: what (kya), why (kyun), evidence (saboot).
  Teaching pattern: 1) what is common. 2) criteria one at a time, both sides together. 3) the reason behind each difference. 4) the most confused pair named directly. 5) difference table as recap.
- timeline · Timeline: Events placed in time: history, the development of an idea, stages of a life (the Revolt of 1857, evolution of cell theory). Required questions: when (kab), why (kyun). Other questions: who (kaun), where (kahan), consequence (nateeja).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the period and its atmosphere. 2) events in order with their causes. 3) the people and their choices. 4) the turning point. 5) what changed after. 6) timeline recap.
- cause_effect · Reasoning (cause and effect): Why something happens: causes, effects, conditions and chains of reasoning (why tissues specialise, why prices rise, why a law was needed). Required questions: why (kyun), how (kaise). Other questions: consequence (nateeja), evidence (saboot), exception (tulna).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the effect students can see. 2) the cause. 3) each link of the chain with its mechanism. 4) the evidence. 5) the exception or limit. 6) the chain as recap.
- facts_numbers · Facts and numbers: Stated facts, quantities, measurements, statistics and formulas (heart rate 72 per minute, 3,000 against 50,000 soldiers at Plassey, F = ma). Required questions: what (kya), evidence (saboot). Other questions: compare (tulna), why (kyun).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the fact in one line. 2) the number shown to scale against something familiar. 3) where it comes from (book or outside, dated). 4) what it changes or proves. 5) a formula built term by term when there is one.
- figure · Figure: A diagram, photo, map, graph or table drawing on the page whose content is visual (tissue pages 2, 7 and 8 are figures only). Required questions: what (kya), which (kaun). Other questions: how (kaise), why (kyun).
  Teaching pattern: 1) what the figure is and why it is here. 2) a reading path across it (labels in order). 3) the one thing to remember from it. 4) link back to the text it explains.
- definition · Definition: A term and its meaning as the book states it (tissue, meristem, sovereignty). Required questions: what (kya), evidence (saboot). Other questions: about (kya), why (kyun).
  Teaching pattern: 1) a concrete example first. 2) the book's definition word by word. 3) a non-example that tests the boundary. 4) where the term is used next in the chapter.

How real teachers open a book line (teacher example bank 2026-10-29.1; use these ways, in your own words):
- Open with a question on something visible (every new topic and every new family member): Skin aur stomach, kidney ke upar ek outer layer hai ki nahi? Yeh kis se bani hai? — phir naam: epithelial tissue.
- One everyday image per shape or function (every term that names a shape, a layer or a job): Chaadar bichhi ho to bistar bacha rehta hai = protective sheet. Cube wala game, har side barabar = cuboidal. Building ka pillar = columnar. Farsh ki tiles = squamous, isliye tessellated bhi kehte hain.
- The word root where it helps (a term whose parts carry its meaning): Epi yaani upar; epithelium yaani upar ki parat. Slender yaani long aur narrow.
- Why starts from a need (every why step): Pet mein HCl banta hai, isliye andar ek lining chahiye jo khud na jale. Cells bahar ki taraf hain, tootne ka chance zyada, isliye regeneration zyada.
- Contrast with the neighbour (members of one family, and what the exam confuses): Simple epithelium ka kaam protection nahi, woh compound ka hai. Zyada layers = pathogen andar nahi aata.
- Ask and repeat the key word (the one word the learner must keep): Irregular walls. Kaisi? Irregular.
- Exam memory beats by level (after the understanding, by the level profile): Yaad rakhna: brush border PCT mein. Doosre naam: pavement, tessellated. M2B = muscle to bone = tendon, B2B = bone to bone = ligament.
- Link to something already known (a new place or a new structure): Peritoneum, jaise lungs ke aas-paas pleura aur heart ke aas-paas pericardium: wahi kaam, pet ke andar.
- Meaning with two or three real examples (an abstract word in the book): Sensory perception yaani pehchanna: thanda lagna, dard hona, pressure mehsoos karna.
- Open the book's adjective (Navin's example) (a book line names a kind of surface, job or place without saying what it is): Book: 'epithelium absorptive aur secretive surfaces par milta hai'. Teacher: absorptive surface yaani jahan cheezein andar li jaati hain, jaise aant khane ke poshak tatva sokhti hai; secretive yaani jahan cells kuch bana kar bahar chhodte hain, jaise glands enzyme ya juice. Aur epithelium wahan kyon? Kyunki ek patli, lagi hui parat hi cheezon ko paar jaane de sakti hai aur bana kar chhod sakti hai.
- Apply it in the real world first, then name it (Navin's sugar shop) (every economics concept (a definition, a cause-and-effect chain, a process): the example runs before the term is named): Ek kirana shop mein chini ke 3 packet hain, ₹50 ka ek. Kal 2 khareedar aaye the, aaj 12 aa gaye; sab ko chini chahiye par packet 3 hi hain. Dukandar daam ₹65 kar deta hai; ab sirf 3 log kharid paate hain, baaki 9 khaali haath. Zyada log, utna hi maal, isliye daam upar. Isliye ise demand-pull inflation kehte hain. Phir book ki definition. Phir: yahi aap Diwali se pehle sabzi mandi mein dekhte hain.

Video v13: RuPay, e-RUPI और merchant को मिलने वाली रकम
Goal: Learner RuPay card types, domestic role और overseas links समझेगा; e-RUPI की beneficiary–purpose restrictions और MDR के payer, recipients तथा gross–net calculation को अलग कर सकेगा।
Opening hook: Customer ने पूरा payment किया, फिर merchant के account में उससे कम रकम क्यों आ सकती है?
Story or analogy: पहले card family का overview और types की समान criteria पर comparison होगी। फिर purpose-bound voucher की situation से e-RUPI समझेंगे। Supplied 2% MDR example में gross amount से fee और net receipt निकालकर fee distribution के participants जोड़ेंगे; voucher को Digital Rupee या खुली cash payment नहीं मानेंगे।
Planned minutes: 9
Narration time (S2-01): 8.1-10.7 minutes, about 1053-1391 spoken words (BIE counts 130 words a minute)
Prerequisites already taught in the prerequisite video (remind of one in at most 2 beats): Purchases, prices, debts and payments due later; Bank balances, deposits, loans and interest; Denominations, monetary arithmetic, percentages and minimum–maximum limits; Purchasing power, inflation, scarcity and liquidity; Central bank, commercial bank, government treasury and bank-to-bank settlement; Foreign currencies, exchange rates, reserves and demand–supply changes; Chronological reading: BCE/CE, centuries, dynasties and law versus implementation dates; Digital instructions, identity authentication, ledgers and payment interfaces
Open every book line (S2-07): a question about something the learner can see, then the name; every term opened: its plain meaning with 'yaani' and one everyday image (the word root where it helps); the why, starting from a need or a problem, one link at a time; an example or the place, by a zoom from the organ or the thing the learner knows; the consequence: what follows, and the link to the previous or the next idea; the contrast: what it is not, and what the exam confuses it with; the memory beat by level: the exam's 'yaad rakhna', the other names, the trick.

p015-i7 | 15 | list_point | facts_numbers | Rupee + Payment = RuPay card . It was launched by NPCI.
  p015-i7#q1 | what | What naming and launch facts are supplied? → The name combines Rupee and Payment, and the launch institution is NPCI. The section title gives 2012. | book
  p015-i7#q2 | evidence | Is the plus-and-equals expression a monetary equation? → No. The displayed words join parts of a name; they do not express amounts or units. | book
  p015-i7#q3 | how | How does the word construction help recall the brand? → Remember the opening of Rupee and the opening of Payment together as RuPay, then separately recall NPCI as the launching institution. | book
  term | Rupee + Payment = RuPay | yaani दो शब्दों के हिस्से मिलाकर RuPay नाम बना है | image: Rupee और Payment के टुकड़े जोड़कर नाम बनाना
  why | A payment brand needs a recognisable name. [standard] → The book connects RuPay's name to Rupee and Payment. [book]
  example or place | The RuPay name on a payment card.
  consequence | The name and its institutional origin become separate recall points.
  visual | join word fragments

  p015-i8#q1 | compare | With which payment brands does the book compare RuPay? → It places RuPay alongside Mastercard, Visa and China's Union Pay as similar payment systems. | book
  p015-i8#q2 | difference | Does the page establish detailed operational differences among these brands? → No. This line gives similarity and calls RuPay the world's seventh payment gateway; it supplies no criteria or comparative operating details. | book
  p015-i8#q3 | why | Why is 'seventh' not evidence of market share or payment volume? → An ordinal without a stated metric cannot establish a ranking by size, transactions or quality. | outside
  p015-i8#q4 | what | What standard name corresponds to the printed 'Visacard'? → The standard payment-network brand name is Visa; 'Visacard' is the book's printed wording. | outside
  p015-i8#q5 | difference | How do card payment networks differ from payment gateways? → RuPay, Visa and Mastercard are card payment networks or schemes connecting participating issuers and acquirers under payment rules. A payment gateway handles the capture and routing of payment information between a merchant's payment interface and payment-processing services. These are distinct roles, even though the book uses 'payment gateway' broadly. | outside
  term | payment gateway | yaani यहाँ card payment चलाने वाली व्यवस्था के लिए इस्तेमाल किया गया शब्द | image: card से दुकान तक payment जोड़ने वाला रास्ता

  example or place | Names displayed on payment cards.
  consequence | Functional similarity should not be mistaken for identical ownership or a size ranking.
  visual | place payment brands side by side
  level extra | Outside clarification, explained in the teacher answers: Visa is the standard name; card networks/schemes and payment gateways have distinct roles.

  p015-i9#q1 | compare | Which comparison does the book make about fees? → It says RuPay charges lower fees than other companies, without providing a fee schedule or numerical comparison. | book
  p015-i9#q2 | difference | What national identity does the page assign to RuPay? → It identifies RuPay as India's domestic payment system. | book
  p015-i9#q3 | why | Why should lower fees not be translated into every transaction being free? → A lower charge is not the same as a zero charge, and the line does not specify the payer, transaction category or amount. | outside
  term | domestic payment system | yaani भारत की अपनी payment व्यवस्था | image: भारत से जुड़ा card brand, जिसका इस्तेमाल बाहर भी हो सकता है
  why | Payment arrangements can differ in fees and home-country identity. [standard] → The book presents RuPay as lower-fee and Indian domestic. [book]
  example or place | RuPay compared with the preceding international card brands.
  consequence | Neither domestic origin nor lower fees establishes universal free use.
  visual | compare fee labels and highlight Indian origin
  level extra | No numerical savings may be inferred because the book gives none.
p015-i10 | 15 | list_point | classification | Types of Cards: RuPay debit, credit, and prepaid cards.
  p015-i10#q1 | which | Which card types does RuPay include? → The page lists debit, credit and prepaid cards. | book
  p015-i10#q2 | difference | What distinguishes these three types? → Debit generally uses money in a linked bank account; credit uses an approved borrowing limit repayable later; prepaid uses value loaded in advance. | outside
  p015-i10#q3 | how | How can one brand span all three? → The network brand and the source of spending funds are different dimensions: the same card network can support account-funded, borrowed and preloaded spending. | outside
  term | debit | yaani खर्च अपने जुड़े bank खाते के पैसे से | image: अपने बटुए के पैसे खर्च करना
  term | credit | yaani अभी उधार की limit से खर्च, भुगतान बाद में | image: दुकान की उधारी बाद में चुकाना
  term | prepaid | yaani पहले पैसे भरना, फिर उसी जमा value से खर्च करना | image: पहले recharge किया हुआ balance

p015-i11 | 15 | list_point | facts_numbers | Rupay debit card given free with PMJDY (Jan Dhan) Bank account.
  p015-i11#q1 | what | What provision accompanies the Jan Dhan account according to the page? → A RuPay debit card is given free with a PMJDY bank account. | book
  p015-i11#q2 | evidence | Which precise card type is mentioned? → The bullet specifies a debit card, not a credit or prepaid card. | book
  p015-i11#q3 | why | Why does a debit card complement account access? → It provides a payment and withdrawal instrument linked to the account, making the account more usable beyond branch visits. | outside
  term | PMJDY (Jan Dhan) | yaani यहाँ Jan Dhan bank खाते वाली योजना | image: नए खाते के साथ मिला debit card
  why | An account holder needs ways to use account money. [standard] → The page links a free RuPay debit card with Jan Dhan accounts. [book]
  example or place | A PMJDY account holder's RuPay debit card.
  consequence | Links RuPay to financial inclusion rather than only commercial card payments.
  visual | attach a debit card to a Jan Dhan account
  level extra | Distinguish free issuance from transaction charges and from credit access.
p015-i12 | 15 | list_point | facts_numbers | One of India's major payment innovations is linking RuPay Credit Cards to UPI.
  p015-i12#q1 | what | Which card linkage is highlighted? → The page identifies linking RuPay credit cards to UPI as a major payment innovation. | book
  p015-i12#q2 | evidence | Does the wording concern debit cards or credit cards? → It explicitly specifies RuPay Credit Cards. | book
  p015-i12#q3 | how | How should the learner separate payment interface from funding source? → UPI is the payment interface in this linkage, while the linked credit card supplies the credit funding. Linkage does not turn borrowed spending into a bank-deposit debit. | outside
  term | linking RuPay Credit Cards to UPI | yaani UPI payment में जुड़े RuPay credit card की credit सुविधा इस्तेमाल करना | image: payment का रास्ता UPI, पैसे का स्रोत credit card
  why | The way a payment is initiated and the source of its funds need not be the same thing. [standard] → The page highlights the connection of RuPay credit cards with UPI. [book]

  consequence | The funding distinction remains important even when the interface looks familiar.

  term | accepted | yaani उस जगह card से payment या withdrawal हो सके | image: दुकान की machine पर card चलना

frame.process: Identify RuPay's name, launch, domestic linkages and overseas milestones.
frame.how: Separate naming, account provision, credit linkage, issuance and acceptance.
frame.when: Launch in 2012; overseas issuance notes associate Bhutan with 2020 and Mauritius with 2024.
frame.conditions: Acceptance concerns the listed use points, not every outlet in a country.
frame.atmosphere: A cardholder examining a card and considering domestic and overseas use.

skipped_steps.why: These naming and country facts contain no formula.

frame.process: Compare RuPay with familiar payment brands.
frame.how: Compare shared payment function, domestic identity and the qualitative fee claim.
frame.when: When identifying a payment brand rather than a card funding type.
frame.conditions: Lower fees do not mean zero fees; the ordinal is not a size metric.
frame.atmosphere: Payment brand names displayed together.

frame.process: Classify RuPay cards by their funding source.
frame.how: Contrast linked-account funds, borrowing and preloaded value.
frame.when: Debit draws on account funds, credit is repaid later, prepaid is funded before spending.
frame.conditions: Network identity and funding source are separate dimensions.
frame.atmosphere: A learner choosing among three cards carrying the same brand.

frame.process: Read the overseas country inset.
frame.how: Follow the six country notes from top to bottom and distinguish issuance from acceptance.
frame.when: Read dates only with their associated issuance notes.
frame.conditions: Flags and coloured dots identify entries, not quantities or a travel route.
frame.atmosphere: Six vertically arranged country flags with matching notes.

frame.process: Define the prepaid electronic voucher and its two restrictions.
frame.how: First redeem a hypothetical vaccination voucher, then unpack its delivery and meaning.
frame.when: Funding precedes redemption for the intended service.
frame.conditions: The intended beneficiary must use it for the intended service.
frame.atmosphere: Government support delivered to a phone for vaccination.

frame.process: Distinguish a restricted voucher from other digital instruments.
frame.how: Use the gift-coupon analogy while retaining person and purpose restrictions.
frame.when: After establishing what the voucher does.
frame.conditions: Digital delivery does not make it an app, transfer or currency.
frame.atmosphere: A phone containing a service coupon rather than unrestricted money.

frame.conditions: Cash withdrawal and unrelated purchases are excluded.
frame.atmosphere: A hypothetical COVID vaccination transaction, not a reported programme.

frame.process: Identify permitted and excluded uses of the voucher.
frame.how: Contrast authorised vaccination redemption with cash withdrawal and other spending.

frame.conditions: Both the service and the authorised centre must match.

frame.process: Define MDR through the difference between sale value and merchant receipt.

frame.atmosphere: A kirana seller accepting a customer's card.

frame.process: Identify the participants sharing the merchant-paid fee.

frame.atmosphere: A payment arrangement with several participants rather than one fee recipient.

frame.process: Identify the direct MDR payer.

frame.atmosphere: The customer pays ₹1,000 and the merchant retains ₹980.

skipped_steps.why: The payer fact contains no separate formula; arithmetic is taught with the figure.

frame.process: Read the card-payment diagram and verify its net receipt.

beats.say: आपने पूरा bill दिया, फिर दुकानदार को कम पैसे क्यों मिले? Card, voucher और fee को अलग करके समझिए।
beats.on_screen: Full customer payment; smaller merchant receipt?

beats.say: Card पर RuPay देखा है? Rupee और Payment जोड़कर नाम बना, यानी 2 टुकड़ों से बना नाम। NPCI ने 2012 में launch किया; यहाँ plus शब्द जोड़ता है, रुपये नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Join word fragments: Rupee + Payment → RuPay. NPCI; 2012. Not a monetary equation.

beats.say: Jan Dhan खाते के साथ क्या मिलता है? PMJDY में free RuPay debit card, यानी खाते के साथ मिला card। RuPay Credit Cards को UPI से जोड़ना अलग innovation है, जैसे card और payment का रास्ता जोड़ना।
beats.on_screen: PMJDY account + free RuPay debit card. Separately: RuPay credit card linked to UPI.

beats.say: विदेश में नया card कहाँ मिला? Bhutan पहला overseas issuance देश है, 2020 में; Mauritius में शुरुआत 2024 में हुई। Issuance यानी ग्राहक को नया card देना, जैसे खाते के साथ card मिलना।
beats.on_screen: Bhutan: first overseas issuance, 2020. Mauritius: issuance, 2024.

beats.say: Nepal और Maldives में ATMs तथा PoS terminals पर acceptance है। यानी cash की machine और दुकान के bill counter पर card चलना। Nepal को acceptance से जोड़िए, card जारी होने के साल से नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Nepal / Maldives: ATM + PoS acceptance. Nepal: acceptance fact, not a dated issuance milestone.

beats.say: Bhutan में ATMs और merchants पर acceptance भी है। UAE और Singapore में ATMs तथा merchant terminals हैं, यानी दुकानदार की payment लेने वाली machines।
beats.on_screen: Bhutan: ATM + merchants; UAE / Singapore: ATM + merchant terminals.

beats.say: 2020 से 2024 में 4 साल का अंतर है; Bhutan पहले, Mauritius बाद में याद रखिए।
beats.on_screen: 2020 Bhutan — 4 years — 2024 Mauritius.

beats.say: जोड़ियाँ पकड़िए: Jan Dhan में debit; UPI linkage में credit।
beats.on_screen: Jan Dhan → debit; UPI linkage → credit.

beats.say: नाम, launch, card type और overseas activity अलग याद रखिए; इससे गलत जोड़ी पकड़ सकेंगे।
beats.on_screen: Name / launch / type / overseas activity.

beats.say: Card पर अलग logos क्यों हैं? RuPay की तुलना Mastercard, Visa और China's Union Pay से है; ये payment व्यवस्था की पहचान हैं, जैसे card पर लगा नाम।
beats.on_screen: Payment brand names on cards.

beats.say: RuPay भारत का domestic payment system है, यानी अपनी व्यवस्था; दूसरी companies से fees कम हैं, जरूरी नहीं zero हों।
beats.on_screen: Indian domestic system; lower fees ≠ zero.

beats.say: Domestic पहचान बताता है, इस्तेमाल की सीमा नहीं; इसीलिए विदेश में acceptance से टकराव नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Domestic origin; overseas use possible.

beats.say: World's 7th payment gateway वाला परिचय सातवाँ सबसे बड़ा होने का दावा नहीं है; इसे हर operational फर्क की तुलना भी मत समझिए।
beats.on_screen: Seventh description ≠ size ranking or operational comparison.

beats.say: तुलना में समान payment भूमिका, Indian पहचान और कम fees रखिए; सभी नियम समान मत मानिए।
beats.on_screen: Role | origin | fees.

beats.say: RuPay में कौन-से cards हैं? Debit, credit और prepaid; फर्क है पैसे कहाँ से आते हैं।
beats.on_screen: RuPay → debit / credit / prepaid. Compare where spending funds come from.

beats.say: अपने खाते से खर्च हो तो? Debit linked bank account के पैसे इस्तेमाल करता है, जैसे अपना बटुआ।
beats.on_screen: Debit: linked account funds.
beats.source: RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card—Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022

beats.say: खरीद अभी, चुकाना बाद में हो तो? Credit approved borrowing limit देता है, यानी उधार से खर्च।
beats.on_screen: Credit: borrow now; repay later.
beats.source: RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card—Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022

beats.say: पहले balance भरकर खर्च करें तो? Prepaid में value पहले load होती है, जैसे पहले कराया recharge।
beats.on_screen: Prepaid: load first; spend later.
beats.source: RBI, Master Directions on Prepaid Payment Instruments, 2021

beats.say: Debit में खाता, credit में उधार, prepaid में loaded value है। Brand और funding अलग हैं, इसलिए RuPay तीनों में आता है।
beats.on_screen: Account | borrowing | preloaded value.
beats.source: RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card Directions, 2022; Prepaid Payment Instruments Directions, 2021

beats.say: चाबी है अपना खाता, उधार, पहले भरा पैसा; RuPay को केवल debit मत मानिए।
beats.on_screen: RuPay is not debit-only.

beats.say: इन flags के notes क्या दिखाते हैं? Overseas RuPay inset में issuance और acceptance देखिए, यात्रा का रास्ता नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Six country rows; no travel route.

beats.say: ऊपर से Bhutan, Nepal, Mauritius, UAE, Singapore, Maldives पढ़िए। रंग matching tags जैसे हैं: देश को उसके note से जोड़ते हैं, मात्रा नहीं बताते।
beats.on_screen: Highlight each flag, dot and matching note in order.

beats.say: Bhutan–2020 और Mauritius–2024 issuance की जोड़ियाँ हैं। नया card मिलना issuance है; दुकान पर चलना acceptance है।
beats.on_screen: Receive a card ≠ use a card.

beats.say: चित्र domestic system के overseas links समझाता है; हर दुकान या ATM पर acceptance मत मानिए।
beats.on_screen: Overseas links ≠ universal acceptance.

beats.say: सरकार आपकी ₹1,000 की COVID vaccination कराना चाहे तो? मान लीजिए खाते में पैसे भेजने के बजाय आपके लिए ₹1,000 का voucher SMS या QR code से भेजती है।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical vaccination support: ₹1,000 voucher, not account cash.

beats.say: आप authorised centre पर वही voucher देकर vaccination लेते हैं। पूरे ₹1,000 की सेवा मिलने पर ₹0 बाकी हैं; cash निकालना या दूसरी खरीदारी करना allowed नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Redeem for vaccination; ₹0 unused; block cash and other purchases.

beats.say: यही e-RUPI है, 2021 से जुड़ा SMS / QR Code based Prepaid Cashless Electronic Voucher। National Payments Corporation of India, यानी NPCI ने इसे अपने UPI platform पर बनाया; phone इसका delivery माध्यम (medium) है।
beats.on_screen: e-RUPI: 2021; NPCI; UPI platform; SMS / QR delivery.

beats.say: Prepaid यानी value पहले funded; cashless यानी सेवा लेते समय cash नहीं देते। Person-specific यानी तय व्यक्ति; purpose-specific यानी तय काम, जैसे आपकी vaccination।
beats.on_screen: Funded first; no cash at redemption; person + purpose locks.

beats.say: खाते में खुले खर्च के ₹1,000 आना इसका उदाहरण नहीं; voucher में इस्तेमाल की शर्तें रहती हैं।
beats.on_screen: Unrestricted account credit ≠ restricted voucher.

beats.say: दो सवाल याद रखिए: कौन इस्तेमाल करेगा और किस काम के लिए? दोनों तय हैं।
beats.on_screen: Intended person + intended service.

beats.say: Phone पर coupon दिखे तो क्या पैसा है? इसे digital gift coupon with restrictions समझिए, यानी सेवा लेने की पर्ची जिस पर ताले लगे हैं।
beats.on_screen: Digital service coupon with person and purpose locks.

beats.say: e-RUPI payment app, bank transfer या digital currency नहीं है। यानी phone पर ₹1,000 दिखने पर भी उससे राशन नहीं खरीद सकते; यहाँ vaccination का voucher है।
beats.on_screen: Vaccination voucher ≠ app / bank transfer / digital currency. Block grocery purchase.

beats.say: वजह targeted service है; gift coupon सुनकर हर खरीदारी की छूट मत जोड़िए।
beats.on_screen: Coupon analogy retains restrictions.

beats.say: e-RUPI को Digital Rupee मत समझिए; UPI platform भी इसे सामान्य bank transfer नहीं बनाता।
beats.on_screen: e-RUPI ≠ Digital Rupee.

beats.say: पहचान काम से कीजिए: यह restricted voucher है, खुला पैसा नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Restricted voucher, not unrestricted money.

beats.say: ₹1,000 वाली मदद का result क्या चाहिए? Vaccination मिले, खुले खर्च की रकम नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Result: vaccination received.

beats.say: सरकार, beneficiary और authorised centre इसमें शामिल हैं; ₹1,000 hypothetical रकम है, universal limit नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Actors and setting; illustrative ₹1,000.

beats.say: पहले voucher phone पर आता है; फिर centre पर redeem होता है, यानी उसके बदले vaccination मिलती है।
beats.on_screen: Delivery → authorised redemption.

beats.say: Cash निकालने की कोशिश allowed नहीं; ऐसा हो तो तय सेवा वाली रोक हट जाएगी।
beats.on_screen: Block cash withdrawal.

beats.say: सरकार भेजती है, beneficiary सही centre जाता है और vaccination लेता है।
beats.on_screen: Animate government delivery → beneficiary → authorised centre → vaccination.

beats.say: Flow है delivery, authorised redemption, intended service; कोई भी खरीदारी नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Delivery → authorised redemption → intended service.

beats.say: कहाँ इस्तेमाल होगा? Authorised vaccination centre पर; cash या दूसरी खरीदारी में नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Allowed centre and service; excluded cash and purchases.

beats.say: ₹1,000 का service voucher होना ₹1,000 cash होना नहीं; खरीदने की आजादी अलग है।
beats.on_screen: Service value ≠ unrestricted cash.

beats.say: ‘Only’ और ‘authorized’ को दो तालों जैसा समझिए: सही काम और सही जगह, दोनों चाहिए।
beats.on_screen: Two locks: service + authorised location.

beats.say: Redemption से सेवा मिलती है; voucher की value को खुले खर्च की छूट मत मानिए।
beats.on_screen: Redeem for service, not cash.

beats.say: किराने का ₹1,000 bill card से दिया, फिर दुकान को कितना मिला? मान लीजिए 2% fee के ₹20 कटे; दुकानदार को ₹980 मिले।
beats.on_screen: Pay ₹1,000; deduct ₹20; merchant gets ₹980.

beats.say: यही Merchant Discount Rate, MDR है: seller हर card transaction पर अपने acquirer bank को fee देता है, यानी merchant की तरफ के bank को।
beats.on_screen: Merchant-side card fee → acquiring bank.

beats.say: Discount का मतलब buyer को छूट नहीं; buyer ने पूरा ₹1,000 bill दिया है।
beats.on_screen: Not a customer price discount.

problems.problem: The participant structure is largely a recipient list. Merchant-side and customer-side labels do not explain what the acquirer and issuer do; the network and applicable gateway have no functional explanation. Consequently, the learner is told that MDR is shared without understanding how the participants work together or why they receive it.
problems.fix: Explain merchant acceptance through the acquirer, card provision through the issuer, payment-message connection through the network, and the applicable provider/gateway's technical interface. Connect those services to fee sharing. Replace b52's counter analogy and compress b54 and b57 to fund this explanation.

problems.problem: The RuPay credit-card–UPI linkage is named and pictured as connecting a card to a route, but its economic meaning is not taught. The later funding classification never connects back to show that the familiar UPI interface can draw on credit rather than deposited money.
problems.fix: Explicitly connect the linkage to the classification: payment is initiated through UPI, but spending uses the linked credit card's borrowing facility and must be repaid. Replace b8's repeated debit/credit pairing with this explanation rather than adding another recap.

problems.problem: The narration repeats 'world's 7th payment gateway' without distinguishing a card network from a payment gateway. Calling all of these merely payment arrangements leaves an exam-relevant category confusion, especially when the gateway later appears as a separate MDR participant.
problems.fix: Retain the supplied seventh-system description without implying a size ranking, but clarify that RuPay, Visa and Mastercard are card networks, whereas a gateway handles payment information from the merchant interface. Replace b14's generic recap with the distinction and carry it into c32.2.

problems.problem: The vaccination transaction and its restrictions are repeatedly retaught: b25–b26 run it, b36–b41 run it again, and b42–b45 repeat its permitted use and cash exclusion. Several consecutive recaps duplicate the same takeaway rather than advancing the explanation.
problems.fix: Integrate these parts into one coherent transaction with one fast process recap. Keep every required distinction, but remove duplicate restriction recaps. Use the recovered space for participant functions, the credit-funding link and a compact side-by-side comparison of voucher, app, transfer and currency.

frame.process: Trace the vaccination voucher from government support to redemption.
frame.how: Government sends a ₹1,000 SMS or QR voucher; the recipient redeems it at an authorised centre.
frame.when: Allocation and delivery precede redemption.
frame.conditions: Cash withdrawal and unrelated purchases are excluded.
frame.atmosphere: A hypothetical COVID vaccination transaction, not a reported programme.

frame.process: Identify permitted and excluded uses of the voucher.
frame.how: Contrast authorised vaccination redemption with cash withdrawal and other spending.
frame.when: At the point of attempted use.
frame.conditions: Both the service and the authorised centre must match.
frame.atmosphere: A beneficiary presenting the voucher at a vaccination centre.

skipped_steps.why: The use restriction has no formula.

frame.process: Define MDR through the difference between sale value and merchant receipt.
frame.how: A ₹1,000 card purchase leaves ₹980 after the illustrated ₹20 fee.
frame.when: During card acceptance and the resulting merchant receipt.
frame.conditions: The example assumes 2%; this is not presented as a universal rate.
frame.atmosphere: A kirana seller accepting a customer's card.

frame.process: Identify the participants sharing the merchant-paid fee.
frame.how: Move from the merchant's acquiring bank to the customer's issuing bank, network and applicable provider.
frame.when: Distinguish fee collection from its distribution.
frame.conditions: Provider or gateway participation is qualified by 'where applicable'; shares are unspecified.
frame.atmosphere: A payment arrangement with several participants rather than one fee recipient.

frame.process: Identify the direct MDR payer.
frame.how: Locate the deduction on the merchant's receipt rather than adding it to the customer's payment.
frame.when: When separating the buyer's purchase payment from the seller's fee.
frame.conditions: The statement concerns the direct fee obligation.
frame.atmosphere: The customer pays ₹1,000 and the merchant retains ₹980.

skipped_steps.why: The payer fact contains no separate formula; arithmetic is taught with the figure.

frame.process: Read the card-payment diagram and verify its net receipt.
frame.how: Follow Customer to Merchant to Banks & Payment Network; calculate and subtract the total fee.
frame.when: Read the purchase arrow first, fee-sharing arrow second and net-receipt line last.
frame.conditions: 2% applies to ₹1,000 in this illustration; ₹20 is the total fee, not each participant's share.
frame.atmosphere: Three boxes with two rightward arrows and a net-receipt calculation.

beats.say: आपने पूरा bill दिया, फिर दुकानदार को कम पैसे क्यों मिले? Card, voucher और fee को अलग करके समझिए।
beats.on_screen: Full customer payment; smaller merchant receipt?

beats.say: Card पर RuPay देखा है? Rupee और Payment जोड़कर नाम बना, यानी 2 टुकड़ों से बना नाम। NPCI ने 2012 में launch किया; यहाँ plus शब्द जोड़ता है, रुपये नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Join word fragments: Rupee + Payment → RuPay. NPCI; 2012. Not a monetary equation.

beats.say: Jan Dhan खाते के साथ क्या मिलता है? PMJDY में free RuPay debit card, यानी खाते के साथ मिला card। RuPay Credit Cards को UPI से जोड़ना अलग innovation है, जैसे card और payment का रास्ता जोड़ना।
beats.on_screen: PMJDY account + free RuPay debit card. Separately: RuPay credit card linked to UPI.

beats.say: विदेश में नया card कहाँ मिला? Bhutan पहला overseas issuance देश है, 2020 में; Mauritius में शुरुआत 2024 में हुई। Issuance यानी ग्राहक को नया card देना, जैसे खाते के साथ card मिलना।
beats.on_screen: Bhutan: first overseas issuance, 2020. Mauritius: issuance, 2024.

beats.say: Nepal और Maldives में ATMs तथा PoS terminals पर acceptance है। यानी cash की machine और दुकान के bill counter पर card चलना। Nepal को acceptance से जोड़िए, card जारी होने के साल से नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Nepal / Maldives: ATM + PoS acceptance. Nepal: acceptance fact, not a dated issuance milestone.

beats.say: Bhutan में ATMs और merchants पर acceptance भी है। UAE और Singapore में ATMs तथा merchant terminals हैं, यानी दुकानदार की payment लेने वाली machines।
beats.on_screen: Bhutan: ATM + merchants; UAE / Singapore: ATM + merchant terminals.

beats.say: 2020 से 2024 में 4 साल का अंतर है; Bhutan पहले, Mauritius बाद में याद रखिए।
beats.on_screen: 2020 Bhutan — 4 years — 2024 Mauritius.

beats.say: इस linkage में payment UPI से शुरू होता है, लेकिन खर्च linked RuPay credit card की borrowing facility से होता है। यानी अपना जमा पैसा नहीं, उधार इस्तेमाल किया और बाद में चुकाना होगा; सामने familiar interface होने से funding नहीं बदलती।
beats.on_screen: UPI: payment interface → linked RuPay credit card: borrowing → repayment later. Not a debit from deposited funds.
beats.source: NPCI, Annual Report 2022–23, 2023; RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card—Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022

beats.say: नाम, launch, card type और overseas activity अलग याद रखिए; इससे गलत जोड़ी पकड़ सकेंगे।
beats.on_screen: Name / launch / type / overseas activity.

beats.say: Card पर अलग logos क्यों हैं? RuPay की तुलना Mastercard, Visa और China's Union Pay से है; ये payment व्यवस्था की पहचान हैं, जैसे card पर लगा नाम।
beats.on_screen: Payment brand names on cards.

beats.say: RuPay भारत का domestic payment system है, यानी अपनी व्यवस्था; दूसरी companies से fees कम हैं, जरूरी नहीं zero हों।
beats.on_screen: Indian domestic system; lower fees ≠ zero.

beats.say: Domestic पहचान बताता है, इस्तेमाल की सीमा नहीं; इसीलिए विदेश में acceptance से टकराव नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Domestic origin; overseas use possible.

beats.say: World's 7th payment gateway वाले परिचय को सातवाँ सबसे बड़ा मत समझिए। यह size ranking नहीं है; तकनीकी category में network और gateway अलग हैं।
beats.on_screen: Seventh-system description ≠ size ranking. Card network ≠ payment gateway.
beats.source: RBI, Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways, 2020; NPCI, Annual Report 2022–23, 2023

beats.say: सही फर्क याद रखिए: RuPay, Visa और Mastercard card networks हैं, banks के बीच card payment messages जोड़ते हैं। Gateway merchant के payment interface से जानकारी processing तक पहुँचाता है; दोनों एक भूमिका नहीं हैं।
beats.on_screen: Card network: connects participating banks. Gateway: merchant interface → payment processing.
beats.source: RBI, Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways, 2020; NPCI, Annual Report 2022–23, 2023

beats.say: RuPay में कौन-से cards हैं? Debit, credit और prepaid; फर्क है पैसे कहाँ से आते हैं।
beats.on_screen: RuPay → debit / credit / prepaid. Compare where spending funds come from.

beats.say: अपने खाते से खर्च हो तो? Debit linked bank account के पैसे इस्तेमाल करता है, जैसे अपना बटुआ।
beats.on_screen: Debit: linked account funds.
beats.source: RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card—Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022

beats.say: खरीद अभी, चुकाना बाद में हो तो? Credit approved borrowing limit देता है, यानी उधार से खर्च।
beats.on_screen: Credit: borrow now; repay later.
beats.source: RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card—Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022

beats.say: पहले balance भरकर खर्च करें तो? Prepaid में value पहले load होती है, जैसे पहले कराया recharge।
beats.on_screen: Prepaid: load first; spend later.
beats.source: RBI, Master Directions on Prepaid Payment Instruments, 2021

beats.say: Debit में खाता, credit में उधार, prepaid में loaded value है। Brand और funding अलग हैं, इसलिए RuPay तीनों में आता है।
beats.on_screen: Account | borrowing | preloaded value.
beats.source: RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card Directions, 2022; Prepaid Payment Instruments Directions, 2021

beats.say: चाबी है अपना खाता, उधार, पहले भरा पैसा; RuPay को केवल debit मत मानिए।
beats.on_screen: RuPay is not debit-only.

beats.say: इन flags के notes क्या दिखाते हैं? Overseas RuPay inset में issuance और acceptance देखिए, यात्रा का रास्ता नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Six country rows; no travel route.

beats.say: ऊपर से Bhutan, Nepal, Mauritius, UAE, Singapore, Maldives पढ़िए। रंग matching tags जैसे हैं: देश को उसके note से जोड़ते हैं, मात्रा नहीं बताते।
beats.on_screen: Highlight each flag, dot and matching note in order.

beats.say: Bhutan–2020 और Mauritius–2024 issuance की जोड़ियाँ हैं। नया card मिलना issuance है; दुकान पर चलना acceptance है।
beats.on_screen: Receive a card ≠ use a card.

beats.say: चित्र domestic system के overseas links समझाता है; हर दुकान या ATM पर acceptance मत मानिए।
beats.on_screen: Overseas links ≠ universal acceptance.

beats.say: सरकार आपकी ₹1,000 की COVID vaccination कराना चाहे तो? मान लीजिए खाते में पैसे भेजने के बजाय आपके लिए ₹1,000 का voucher SMS या QR code से भेजती है।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical vaccination support: ₹1,000 voucher, not account cash.

beats.say: आप authorised centre पर वही voucher देकर vaccination लेते हैं। पूरे ₹1,000 की सेवा मिलने पर ₹0 बाकी हैं; cash निकालना या दूसरी खरीदारी करना allowed नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Redeem for vaccination; ₹0 unused; block cash and other purchases.

beats.say: यही e-RUPI है, 2021 से जुड़ा SMS / QR Code based Prepaid Cashless Electronic Voucher। National Payments Corporation of India, यानी NPCI ने इसे अपने UPI platform पर बनाया; phone इसका delivery माध्यम (medium) है।
beats.on_screen: e-RUPI: 2021; NPCI; UPI platform; SMS / QR delivery.

beats.say: Prepaid यानी value पहले funded; cashless यानी सेवा लेते समय cash नहीं देते। Person-specific यानी तय व्यक्ति; purpose-specific यानी तय काम, जैसे आपकी vaccination।
beats.on_screen: Funded first; no cash at redemption; person + purpose locks.

beats.say: खाते में खुले खर्च के ₹1,000 आना इसका उदाहरण नहीं; voucher में इस्तेमाल की शर्तें रहती हैं।
beats.on_screen: Unrestricted account credit ≠ restricted voucher.

beats.say: Definition में instrument voucher है; SMS या QR उसकी delivery है और UPI उसका platform है।
beats.on_screen: Instrument: voucher | Delivery: SMS / QR | Platform: UPI.

beats.say: Phone पर coupon दिखे तो क्या पैसा है? इसे digital gift coupon with restrictions समझिए, यानी सेवा लेने की पर्ची जिस पर ताले लगे हैं।
beats.on_screen: Digital service coupon with person and purpose locks.

beats.say: App payment करने का software interface है; bank transfer खाते में रकम पहुँचाता है। Currency पैसा है, जबकि यह voucher तय सेवा लेने का हक है। इसलिए phone पर दिखने वाली इन चारों चीजों को एक category में मत रखिए।
beats.on_screen: App: interface | Transfer: movement into an account | Currency: money | e-RUPI voucher: specified service entitlement.
beats.source: NPCI, e-RUPI launch announcement, 2021; RBI, Concept Note on Central Bank Digital Currency, 2022

beats.say: Gift coupon की तुलना value redeem करना समझाती है, हर खरीदारी की छूट नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Coupon analogy explains redemption, not unrestricted spending.

beats.say: खास trap है e-RUPI और Digital Rupee: मिलते-जुलते नाम से voucher currency नहीं बनता।
beats.on_screen: e-RUPI voucher ≠ Digital Rupee.

beats.say: तुलना की चाबी काम है, phone पर दिखना नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Classify by function, not digital appearance.

beats.say: इस transaction का result क्या मिला? Vaccination मिली।
beats.on_screen: Highlight the completed vaccination in the existing example.

beats.say: सरकार, beneficiary और authorised centre इसके actors हैं; ₹1,000 illustrative रकम है, universal limit नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Existing example: government / beneficiary / authorised centre. ₹1,000 is illustrative.

beats.say: क्रम में funding और delivery पहले हैं; तय सेवा के बदले redemption बाद में है।
beats.on_screen: Highlight sequence on the existing transaction: funded voucher → delivery → service redemption.

beats.say: Cash withdrawal चुनेंगे तो यह redemption की शर्त पूरी नहीं करेगा।
beats.on_screen: Cash withdrawal fails the permitted-use condition.

beats.say: अब वही transaction तेजी से देखिए: भेजा, दिखाया, सेवा मिली।
beats.on_screen: Replay the existing voucher animation once at speed.

beats.say: पूरा flow delivery से authorised redemption तक है।
beats.on_screen: Delivery → authorised redemption → vaccination.

beats.say: केवल vaccination काफी है? जगह भी authorised centre होनी चाहिए।
beats.on_screen: Permitted service AND authorised location.

beats.say: ₹1,000 की value समान दिखेगी, लेकिन cash जैसी खर्च की आजादी नहीं मिलेगी।
beats.on_screen: Same stated value; different permitted uses.

beats.say: ‘Only’ सेवा को बाँधता है और ‘authorized’ जगह को।
beats.on_screen: Only → service restriction. Authorized → location restriction.

beats.say: इस्तेमाल की eligibility में काम और जगह दोनों जाँचिए।
beats.on_screen: Use check: service + authorised centre.

beats.say: किराने का ₹1,000 bill card से दिया, फिर दुकान को कितना मिला? मान लीजिए 2% fee के ₹20 कटे; दुकानदार को ₹980 मिले।
beats.on_screen: Pay ₹1,000; deduct ₹20; merchant gets ₹980.

beats.say: यही Merchant Discount Rate, MDR है: seller हर card transaction पर अपने acquirer bank को fee देता है, यानी merchant की तरफ के bank को।
beats.on_screen: Merchant-side card fee → acquiring bank.

beats.say: Discount का मतलब buyer को छूट नहीं; buyer ने पूरा ₹1,000 bill दिया है।
beats.on_screen: Not a customer price discount.

beats.say: इसलिए gross sale और net receipt अलग हैं: यहाँ ₹1,000 की बिक्री, ₹980 की receipt।
beats.on_screen: Gross ≠ net.

beats.say: पूरी fee एक bank रखता है? नहीं, MDR कई participants में shared होता है।
beats.on_screen: One fee; several recipients.

beats.say: Merchant से शुरू कीजिए: Acquiring Bank उसकी card payment स्वीकार करने की व्यवस्था देता है। दूसरी तरफ Issuing Bank customer को card देता है; यानी एक bank seller की acceptance से जुड़ा है, दूसरा buyer के card से।
beats.on_screen: Merchant ← acceptance arrangement: Acquiring Bank. Customer ← card provision: Issuing Bank.
beats.source: RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card—Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022; RBI, Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways, 2020

beats.say: दोनों तरफ payment messages कैसे पहुँचेंगे? RuPay, Visa या Mastercard जैसा Card Network उन्हें जोड़ता है। जहाँ Payment Service Provider/Gateway लागू हो, वह merchant interface और payment processing के बीच जानकारी पहुँचाने की technical सुविधा देता है, जैसे checkout से आगे का दरवाजा।
beats.on_screen: Merchant interface → applicable provider/gateway → processing. Card network connects payment messages between participating banks.
beats.source: RBI, Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways, 2020; NPCI, Annual Report 2022–23, 2023

beats.say: अब services जोड़िए: merchant acceptance, customer का card, messages का connection और जहाँ लागू हो technical interface मिलकर payment चलाते हैं। इसलिए acquirer को fee देना उसके पूरी fee रखने के बराबर नहीं; MDR इन participants में share होता है।
beats.on_screen: Acceptance + card provision + message connection + applicable technical interface → shared payment service → shared MDR.
beats.source: RBI, Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways, 2020; RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card—Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022; NPCI, Annual Report 2022–23, 2023

beats.say: Acquirer, issuer, network और applicable provider अलग services देते हैं; shared fee बराबर हिस्से नहीं बताती।
beats.on_screen: Labelled participant map; do not assign equal shares.

beats.say: Direct MDR payer कौन है? Merchant है, customer नहीं; bill और fee अलग रखिए।
beats.on_screen: MDR payer: merchant.

beats.say: Buyer ने ₹1,000 दिए, ₹1,020 नहीं; ₹20 seller की receipt से कटे हैं।
beats.on_screen: Customer ₹1,000; merchant ₹980.

beats.say: इसका सबूत seller की छोटी receipt है।
beats.on_screen: Highlight merchant receipt: ₹980 after the customer's ₹1,000 payment.

beats.say: Exam में payer बदलने का trap पकड़िए: purchase customer करता है, MDR merchant देता है।
beats.on_screen: Purchase payer ≠ MDR payer.

beats.say: तीन boxes कैसे पढ़ेंगे? Customer से Merchant, फिर Banks & Payment Network; यह payment और fee अलग दिखाता है।
beats.on_screen: Customer → Merchant → Banks & Payment Network.

beats.say: बाएँ buyer है; Pays ₹1,000 arrow seller तक जाती है। यह खरीदारी की पूरी रकम है, fee नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Highlight buyer and purchase-payment arrow.

beats.say: बीच के Merchant में payment आती है; MDR shared arrow दाएँ निकलती है। Seller के पास ₹980 रहते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Incoming purchase payment; outgoing shared fee.

beats.say: दायाँ box कई recipients को समेटता है: दोनों banks, network और applicable provider; एक organisation नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Expand grouped box into previously named participants and network examples.

beats.say: 2% यानी हर ₹100 पर ₹2; ₹1,000 पर ₹20 कटे, इसलिए ₹980 मिले। Percent rate है, रुपये receipt हैं।
beats.source: Standard percentage arithmetic applied to the supplied illustration, 2026

beats.say: ₹20 total fee है, हर recipient का हिस्सा नहीं; 2% इसी example की rate है, universal नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Gross ₹1,000; total fee ₹20; net ₹980; illustrative 2%.

beats.say: चित्र definition खोलता है: buyer payment करता है, merchant fee देता है, participants उसे share करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Purchase → merchant deduction → shared fee.

beats.say: अंत में तीन पहचान अलग रखिए: RuPay card brand, e-RUPI restricted voucher, MDR merchant की fee। एक सेवा पर रोक समझाता है, दूसरा net receipt।
beats.on_screen: RuPay: brand | e-RUPI: voucher | MDR: fee.

frame.process: Identify RuPay's name, launch, domestic linkages and overseas milestones.
frame.how: Separate naming, account provision, credit linkage, issuance and acceptance.
frame.when: Launch in 2012; overseas issuance notes associate Bhutan with 2020 and Mauritius with 2024.
frame.conditions: Acceptance concerns the listed use points, not every outlet in a country.
frame.atmosphere: A cardholder examining a card and considering domestic and overseas use.

skipped_steps.why: These naming and country facts contain no formula.

frame.process: Compare RuPay with familiar payment brands.
frame.how: Compare shared payment function, domestic identity and the qualitative fee claim.
frame.when: When identifying a payment brand rather than a card funding type.
frame.conditions: Lower fees do not mean zero fees; the ordinal is not a size metric.
frame.atmosphere: Payment brand names displayed together.

frame.process: Classify RuPay cards by their funding source.
frame.how: Contrast linked-account funds, borrowing and preloaded value.
frame.when: Debit draws on account funds, credit is repaid later, prepaid is funded before spending.
frame.conditions: Network identity and funding source are separate dimensions.
frame.atmosphere: A learner choosing among three cards carrying the same brand.

frame.process: Read the overseas country inset.
frame.how: Follow the six country notes from top to bottom and distinguish issuance from acceptance.
frame.when: Read dates only with their associated issuance notes.
frame.conditions: Flags and coloured dots identify entries, not quantities or a travel route.
frame.atmosphere: Six vertically arranged country flags with matching notes.

frame.process: Define the prepaid electronic voucher and its two restrictions.
frame.how: First redeem a hypothetical vaccination voucher, then unpack its delivery and meaning.
frame.when: Funding precedes redemption for the intended service.
frame.conditions: The intended beneficiary must use it for the intended service.
frame.atmosphere: Government support delivered to a phone for vaccination.

frame.process: Distinguish a restricted voucher from other digital instruments.
frame.how: Use the gift-coupon analogy while retaining person and purpose restrictions.
frame.when: After establishing what the voucher does.
frame.conditions: Digital delivery does not make it an app, transfer or currency.
frame.atmosphere: A phone containing a service coupon rather than unrestricted money.

frame.process: Trace the vaccination voucher from government support to redemption.
frame.how: Government sends a ₹1,000 SMS or QR voucher; the recipient redeems it at an authorised centre.
frame.when: Allocation and delivery precede redemption.
frame.conditions: Cash withdrawal and unrelated purchases are excluded.
frame.atmosphere: A hypothetical COVID vaccination transaction, not a reported programme.

frame.process: Identify permitted and excluded uses of the voucher.
frame.how: Contrast authorised vaccination redemption with cash withdrawal and other spending.
frame.when: At the point of attempted use.
frame.conditions: Both the service and the authorised centre must match.
frame.atmosphere: A beneficiary presenting the voucher at a vaccination centre.

skipped_steps.why: The use restriction has no formula.

frame.process: Define MDR through the difference between sale value and merchant receipt.
frame.how: A ₹1,000 card purchase leaves ₹980 after the illustrated ₹20 fee.
frame.when: During card acceptance and the resulting merchant receipt.
frame.conditions: The example assumes 2%; this is not presented as a universal rate.
frame.atmosphere: A kirana seller accepting a customer's card.

frame.process: Identify the participants sharing the merchant-paid fee.
frame.how: Move from the merchant's acquiring bank to the customer's issuing bank, network and applicable provider.
frame.when: Distinguish fee collection from its distribution.
frame.conditions: Provider or gateway participation is qualified by 'where applicable'; shares are unspecified.
frame.atmosphere: A payment arrangement with several participants rather than one fee recipient.

frame.process: Identify the direct MDR payer.
frame.how: Locate the deduction on the merchant's receipt rather than adding it to the customer's payment.
frame.when: When separating the buyer's purchase payment from the seller's fee.
frame.conditions: The statement concerns the direct fee obligation.
frame.atmosphere: The customer pays ₹1,000 and the merchant retains ₹980.

skipped_steps.why: The payer fact contains no separate formula; arithmetic is taught with the figure.

frame.process: Read the card-payment diagram and verify its net receipt.
frame.how: Follow Customer to Merchant to Banks & Payment Network; calculate and subtract the total fee.
frame.when: Read the purchase arrow first, fee-sharing arrow second and net-receipt line last.
frame.conditions: 2% applies to ₹1,000 in this illustration; ₹20 is the total fee, not each participant's share.
frame.atmosphere: Three boxes with two rightward arrows and a net-receipt calculation.

beats.say: आपने पूरा bill दिया, फिर दुकानदार को कम पैसे क्यों मिले? Card, voucher और fee को अलग करके समझिए।
beats.on_screen: Full customer payment; smaller merchant receipt?

beats.say: Card पर RuPay देखा है? Rupee और Payment जोड़कर नाम बना, यानी 2 टुकड़ों से बना नाम। NPCI ने 2012 में launch किया; यहाँ plus शब्द जोड़ता है, रुपये नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Join word fragments: Rupee + Payment → RuPay. NPCI; 2012. Not a monetary equation.

beats.say: Jan Dhan खाते के साथ क्या मिलता है? PMJDY में free RuPay debit card, यानी खाते के साथ मिला card। RuPay Credit Cards को UPI से जोड़ना अलग innovation है, जैसे card और payment का रास्ता जोड़ना।
beats.on_screen: PMJDY account + free RuPay debit card. Separately: RuPay credit card linked to UPI.

beats.say: विदेश में नया card कहाँ मिला? Bhutan पहला overseas issuance देश है, 2020 में; Mauritius में शुरुआत 2024 में हुई। Issuance यानी ग्राहक को नया card देना, जैसे खाते के साथ card मिलना।
beats.on_screen: Bhutan: first overseas issuance, 2020. Mauritius: issuance, 2024.

beats.say: Nepal और Maldives में ATMs तथा PoS terminals पर acceptance है। यानी cash की machine और दुकान के bill counter पर card चलना। Nepal को acceptance से जोड़िए, card जारी होने के साल से नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Nepal / Maldives: ATM + PoS acceptance. Nepal: acceptance fact, not a dated issuance milestone.

beats.say: Bhutan में ATMs और merchants पर acceptance भी है। UAE और Singapore में ATMs तथा merchant terminals हैं, यानी दुकानदार की payment लेने वाली machines।
beats.on_screen: Bhutan: ATM + merchants; UAE / Singapore: ATM + merchant terminals.

beats.say: 2020 से 2024 में 4 साल का अंतर है; Bhutan पहले, Mauritius बाद में याद रखिए।
beats.on_screen: 2020 Bhutan — 4 years — 2024 Mauritius.

beats.say: इस linkage में payment UPI से शुरू होता है, लेकिन खर्च linked RuPay credit card की borrowing facility से होता है। यानी अपना जमा पैसा नहीं, उधार इस्तेमाल किया और बाद में चुकाना होगा; सामने familiar interface होने से funding नहीं बदलती।
beats.on_screen: UPI: payment interface → linked RuPay credit card: borrowing → repayment later. Not a debit from deposited funds.
beats.source: NPCI, Annual Report 2022–23, 2023; RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card—Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022

beats.say: नाम, launch, card type और overseas activity अलग याद रखिए; इससे गलत जोड़ी पकड़ सकेंगे।
beats.on_screen: Name / launch / type / overseas activity.

beats.say: Card पर अलग logos क्यों हैं? RuPay की तुलना Mastercard, Visa और China's Union Pay से है; ये payment व्यवस्था की पहचान हैं, जैसे card पर लगा नाम।
beats.on_screen: Payment brand names on cards.

beats.say: RuPay भारत का domestic payment system है, यानी अपनी व्यवस्था; दूसरी companies से fees कम हैं, जरूरी नहीं zero हों।
beats.on_screen: Indian domestic system; lower fees ≠ zero.

beats.say: Domestic पहचान बताता है, इस्तेमाल की सीमा नहीं; इसीलिए विदेश में acceptance से टकराव नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Domestic origin; overseas use possible.

beats.say: World's 7th payment gateway वाले परिचय को सातवाँ सबसे बड़ा मत समझिए। यह size ranking नहीं है; technical category में network और gateway अलग हैं।
beats.on_screen: Seventh-system description ≠ size ranking. Card network ≠ payment gateway.
beats.source: RBI, Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways, 2020; NPCI, Annual Report 2022–23, 2023

beats.say: सही फर्क याद रखिए: RuPay, Visa और Mastercard card networks हैं, banks के बीच card payment messages जोड़ते हैं। Gateway merchant के payment interface से जानकारी processing तक पहुँचाता है; दोनों एक भूमिका नहीं हैं।
beats.on_screen: Card network: connects participating banks. Gateway: merchant interface → payment processing.
beats.source: RBI, Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways, 2020; NPCI, Annual Report 2022–23, 2023

beats.say: RuPay में कौन-से cards हैं? Debit, credit और prepaid; फर्क है पैसे कहाँ से आते हैं।
beats.on_screen: RuPay → debit / credit / prepaid. Compare where spending funds come from.

beats.say: अपने खाते से खर्च हो तो? Debit linked bank account के पैसे इस्तेमाल करता है, जैसे अपना बटुआ।
beats.on_screen: Debit: linked account funds.
beats.source: RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card—Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022

beats.say: खरीद अभी, चुकाना बाद में हो तो? Credit approved borrowing limit देता है, यानी उधार से खर्च।
beats.on_screen: Credit: borrow now; repay later.
beats.source: RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card—Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022

beats.say: पहले balance भरकर खर्च करें तो? Prepaid में value पहले load होती है, जैसे पहले कराया recharge।
beats.on_screen: Prepaid: load first; spend later.
beats.source: RBI, Master Directions on Prepaid Payment Instruments, 2021

beats.say: Debit में खाता, credit में उधार, prepaid में loaded value है। Brand और funding अलग हैं, इसलिए RuPay तीनों में आता है।
beats.on_screen: Account | borrowing | preloaded value.
beats.source: RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card Directions, 2022; Prepaid Payment Instruments Directions, 2021

beats.say: चाबी है अपना खाता, उधार, पहले भरा पैसा; RuPay को केवल debit मत मानिए।
beats.on_screen: RuPay is not debit-only.

beats.say: इन flags के notes क्या दिखाते हैं? Overseas RuPay inset में issuance और acceptance देखिए, यात्रा का रास्ता नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Six country rows; no travel route.

beats.say: ऊपर से Bhutan, Nepal, Mauritius, UAE, Singapore, Maldives पढ़िए। रंग matching tags जैसे हैं: देश को उसके note से जोड़ते हैं, मात्रा नहीं बताते।
beats.on_screen: Highlight each flag, dot and matching note in order.

beats.say: Bhutan–2020 और Mauritius–2024 issuance की जोड़ियाँ हैं। नया card मिलना issuance है; दुकान पर चलना acceptance है।
beats.on_screen: Receive a card ≠ use a card.

beats.say: चित्र domestic system के overseas links समझाता है; हर दुकान या ATM पर acceptance मत मानिए।
beats.on_screen: Overseas links ≠ universal acceptance.

beats.say: सरकार आपकी ₹1,000 की COVID vaccination कराना चाहे तो? मान लीजिए खाते में पैसे भेजने के बजाय आपके लिए ₹1,000 का voucher SMS या QR code से भेजती है।
beats.on_screen: Hypothetical vaccination support: ₹1,000 voucher, not account cash.

beats.say: आप authorised centre पर वही voucher देकर vaccination लेते हैं। पूरे ₹1,000 की सेवा मिलने पर ₹0 बाकी हैं; cash निकालना या दूसरी खरीदारी करना allowed नहीं है।
beats.on_screen: Redeem for vaccination; ₹0 unused; block cash and other purchases.

beats.say: यही e-RUPI है, 2021 से जुड़ा SMS / QR Code based Prepaid Cashless Electronic Voucher। National Payments Corporation of India, यानी NPCI ने इसे अपने UPI platform पर बनाया; phone इसका delivery माध्यम (medium) है।
beats.on_screen: e-RUPI: 2021; NPCI; UPI platform; SMS / QR delivery.

beats.say: Prepaid यानी value पहले funded; cashless यानी सेवा लेते समय cash नहीं देते। Person-specific यानी तय व्यक्ति; purpose-specific यानी तय काम, जैसे आपकी vaccination।
beats.on_screen: Funded first; no cash at redemption; person + purpose locks.

beats.say: खाते में खुले खर्च के ₹1,000 आना इसका उदाहरण नहीं; voucher में इस्तेमाल की शर्तें रहती हैं।
beats.on_screen: Unrestricted account credit ≠ restricted voucher.

beats.say: Definition में instrument voucher है; SMS या QR उसकी delivery है और UPI उसका platform है।
beats.on_screen: Instrument: voucher | Delivery: SMS / QR | Platform: UPI.

beats.say: Phone पर coupon दिखे तो क्या पैसा है? इसे digital gift coupon with restrictions समझिए, यानी सेवा लेने की पर्ची जिस पर ताले लगे हैं।
beats.on_screen: Digital service coupon with person and purpose locks.

beats.say: App payment करने का software interface है; bank transfer खाते में रकम पहुँचाता है। Currency पैसा है, जबकि यह voucher तय सेवा लेने का हक है। इसलिए phone पर दिखने वाली इन चारों चीजों को एक category में मत रखिए।
beats.on_screen: App: interface | Transfer: movement into an account | Currency: money | e-RUPI voucher: specified service entitlement.
beats.source: NPCI, e-RUPI launch announcement, 2021; RBI, Concept Note on Central Bank Digital Currency, 2022

beats.say: Coupon की तुलना में 2 शर्तें जोड़िए: तय beneficiary ही इस्तेमाल करे, वह भी तय सेवा के लिए।
beats.on_screen: Gift-coupon analogy + intended beneficiary only + intended service only.

beats.say: खास trap है e-RUPI और Digital Rupee: मिलते-जुलते नाम से voucher currency नहीं बनता।
beats.on_screen: e-RUPI voucher ≠ Digital Rupee.

beats.say: तुलना की चाबी काम है, phone पर दिखना नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Classify by function, not digital appearance.

beats.say: इस transaction का result क्या मिला? Vaccination मिली।
beats.on_screen: Highlight the completed vaccination in the existing example.

beats.say: सरकार, beneficiary और authorised centre इसके actors हैं; ₹1,000 illustrative रकम है, universal limit नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Existing example: government / beneficiary / authorised centre. ₹1,000 is illustrative.

beats.say: क्रम में funding और delivery पहले हैं; तय सेवा के बदले redemption बाद में है।
beats.on_screen: Highlight sequence on the existing transaction: funded voucher → delivery → service redemption.

beats.say: Cash withdrawal चुनेंगे तो यह redemption की शर्त पूरी नहीं करेगा।
beats.on_screen: Cash withdrawal fails the permitted-use condition.

beats.say: अब वही transaction तेजी से देखिए: भेजा, दिखाया, सेवा मिली।
beats.on_screen: Replay the existing voucher animation once at speed.

beats.say: पूरा flow delivery से authorised redemption तक है।
beats.on_screen: Delivery → authorised redemption → vaccination.

beats.say: केवल vaccination काफी है? जगह भी authorised centre होनी चाहिए।
beats.on_screen: Permitted service AND authorised location.

beats.say: ₹1,000 की value समान दिखेगी, लेकिन cash जैसी खर्च की आजादी नहीं मिलेगी।
beats.on_screen: Same stated value; different permitted uses.

beats.say: ‘Only’ सेवा को बाँधता है और ‘authorized’ जगह को।
beats.on_screen: Only → service restriction. Authorized → location restriction.

beats.say: इस्तेमाल की eligibility में काम और जगह दोनों जाँचिए।
beats.on_screen: Use check: service + authorised centre.

beats.say: किराने का ₹1,000 bill card से दिया, फिर दुकान को कितना मिला? मान लीजिए 2% fee के ₹20 कटे; दुकानदार को ₹980 मिले।
beats.on_screen: Pay ₹1,000; deduct ₹20; merchant gets ₹980.

beats.say: यही Merchant Discount Rate, MDR है: seller हर card transaction पर अपने acquirer bank को fee देता है, यानी merchant की तरफ के bank को।
beats.on_screen: Merchant-side card fee → acquiring bank.

beats.say: Discount का मतलब buyer को छूट नहीं; buyer ने पूरा ₹1,000 bill दिया है।
beats.on_screen: Not a customer price discount.

beats.say: इसलिए gross sale और net receipt अलग हैं: यहाँ ₹1,000 की बिक्री, ₹980 की receipt।
beats.on_screen: Gross ≠ net.

beats.say: Merchant से शुरू कीजिए: Acquiring Bank उसकी card payment स्वीकार करने की व्यवस्था देता है। दूसरी तरफ Issuing Bank customer को card देता है; यानी एक bank seller की acceptance से जुड़ा है, दूसरा buyer के card से।

beats.source: RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card—Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022; RBI, Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways, 2020

beats.say: दोनों तरफ payment messages कैसे पहुँचेंगे? RuPay, Visa या Mastercard जैसा Card Network उन्हें जोड़ता है। जहाँ Payment Service Provider/Gateway लागू हो, वह merchant interface और payment processing के बीच जानकारी पहुँचाने की technical सुविधा देता है, जैसे checkout से आगे का दरवाजा।
beats.on_screen: Merchant interface → applicable provider/gateway → processing. Card network connects payment messages between participating banks.
beats.source: RBI, Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways, 2020; NPCI, Annual Report 2022–23, 2023

beats.say: अब services जोड़िए: merchant acceptance, customer का card, messages का connection और जहाँ लागू हो technical interface मिलकर payment चलाते हैं। इसलिए acquirer को fee देना उसके पूरी fee रखने के बराबर नहीं; MDR इन participants में share होता है।
beats.on_screen: Acceptance + card provision + message connection + applicable technical interface → shared payment service → shared MDR.
beats.source: RBI, Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways, 2020; RBI, Credit Card and Debit Card—Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022; NPCI, Annual Report 2022–23, 2023

beats.say: Acquirer, issuer, network और applicable provider अलग services देते हैं; shared fee बराबर हिस्से नहीं बताती।

problems.problem: The vaccination transaction and restrictions are repeatedly recapped after b25–b29 already explain them. b36–b41 replay the same transaction, and b42–b45 again state the authorised-service and location conditions. This violates the explicit no-duplicate-recaps requirement and makes the lesson feel like separate checklist readings.

problems.problem: Neither comparison ends with the required difference table. b14 instead adds network-versus-gateway teaching, while b35 provides only a slogan. The learner never receives a consolidated side-by-side comparison on the stated criteria.
problems.fix: Replace these recap beats with compact spoken, on-screen comparison tables. For RuPay, consolidate shared function, Indian domestic identity and the qualitative fee claim without inventing competitor details. For e-RUPI, compare voucher, app, transfer and currency by function and the voucher's restrictions. Fund this replacement by cutting the duplicate voucher summaries.

problems.problem: “एक सेवा पर रोक समझाता है, दूसरा net receipt” has unclear referents after listing three concepts. It can sound as though the voucher prohibits the service rather than restricts spending to it.
problems.fix: Say explicitly: “e-RUPI में व्यक्ति और सेवा तय हैं; MDR से merchant की net receipt घटती है।”

replace_beats.say: Definition की चाबी है voucher; SMS delivery का तरीका है, instrument का नाम नहीं।

replace_beats.say: Table में काम देखकर फर्क कीजिए: app interface है, transfer रकम पहुँचाता है, currency पैसा है, voucher तय सेवा का हक देता है। e-RUPI वाले खाने में 2 ताले जोड़िए: तय beneficiary और तय purpose; gift coupon की तुलना इन्हें हटाती नहीं।

replace_beats.source: NPCI, e-RUPI launch announcement, 2021; RBI, Concept Note on Central Bank Digital Currency, 2022

frame.process: Compare RuPay with familiar payment brands.

frame.conditions: Lower fees do not mean zero fees; the ordinal is not a size metric.
frame.atmosphere: Payment brand names displayed together.

frame.process: Classify RuPay cards by their funding source.
frame.how: Contrast linked-account funds, borrowing and preloaded value.
frame.when: Debit draws on account funds, credit is repaid later, prepaid is funded before spending.
frame.conditions: Network identity and funding source are separate dimensions.
frame.atmosphere: A learner choosing among three cards carrying the same brand.

frame.process: Define the prepaid electronic voucher and its two restrictions.
frame.how: First redeem a hypothetical vaccination voucher, then unpack its delivery and meaning.
frame.when: Funding precedes redemption for the intended service.
frame.conditions: The intended beneficiary must use it for the intended service.
frame.atmosphere: Government support delivered to a phone for vaccination.

frame.process: Distinguish a restricted voucher from other digital instruments.
frame.how: Use the gift-coupon analogy while retaining person and purpose restrictions.
frame.when: After establishing what the voucher does.
frame.conditions: Digital delivery does not make it an app, transfer or currency.
frame.atmosphere: A phone containing a service coupon rather than unrestricted money.

frame.process: Trace the vaccination voucher from government support to redemption.
frame.how: Government sends a ₹1,000 SMS or QR voucher; the recipient redeems it at an authorised centre.
frame.when: Allocation and delivery precede redemption.
frame.conditions: Cash withdrawal and unrelated purchases are excluded.
frame.atmosphere: A hypothetical COVID vaccination transaction, not a reported programme.

frame.process: Identify permitted and excluded uses of the voucher.
frame.how: Contrast authorised vaccination redemption with cash withdrawal and other spending.
frame.when: At the point of attempted use.
frame.conditions: Both the service and the authorised centre must match.
frame.atmosphere: A beneficiary presenting the voucher at a vaccination centre.

frame.process: Define MDR through the difference between sale value and merchant receipt.

frame.conditions: The example assumes 2%; this is not presented as a universal rate.
frame.atmosphere: A kirana seller accepting a customer's card.

frame.process: Identify the participants sharing the merchant-paid fee.
frame.how: Move from the merchant's acquiring bank to the customer's issuing bank, network and applicable provider.
frame.when: Distinguish fee collection from its distribution.
frame.conditions: Provider or gateway participation is qualified by 'where applicable'; shares are unspecified.
frame.atmosphere: A payment arrangement with several participants rather than one fee recipient.

frame.process: Identify the direct MDR payer.

frame.when: When separating the buyer's purchase payment from the seller's fee.
frame.conditions: The statement concerns the direct fee obligation.
frame.atmosphere: The customer pays ₹1,000 and the merchant retains ₹980.
